question: Does the multi-epoch consistency cascade (finite-diff omega from per-epoch C_t pairs + local validation) survive on a high-|omega| seed (14), fixing the s048 low-|omega| failure?
hypothesis: On a high-|omega| seed where per-dt rotation dwarfs sample resolution, the cascade preserves truth-adjacent (q_a, omega) at the expected ~17% omega-noise floor and acts as an LM seed generator.
narrative_md: On seed 14 (|omega|=1.229 dps) the cascade works as the s048 author predicted: the truth-adjacent discrete sample survives at q_dist=0 deg with the expected ~17% omega-noise, and the cascade-derived truth-omega survives K=2-3 at tol>=0.15. 141706 raw hypotheses -> 35835 survivors at tol=0.10/K=3 in 340 s single-thread. Framed as a SEED GENERATOR for LM (17% omega-noise sits inside the LM q-basin). Reads truth-q anchors for the truth-check, so not blind.
